comments.author: IHateChoosing
comments.body_html:
Not easily. Most helmets simply don’t have an attachment point at the back of the head, so that’d mean altering the bundle files, which i won’t do.
At least that’s my understanding of how sam got this to work.

As for helmets that have a slot on the back of the head, like the grom helmet for example, they don’t have it in exactly the correct spot and angle so the goggles line up with the helmet, so the goggles stick up or out front.
